source_signature.notes: Batch 4F skill 5/5, batch closer. Scope Operator-derived. The shear specialization of internal_loading_at_section (the signed parent that finds the full N/V/M trio at a section): this skill owns the internal shear force V, the SigmaFy step that determines it, and the sign convention that makes V a signed quantity rather than a magnitude. Bending moment M is owned by bending_moment_internal_loading; shear/moment diagrams and the dV/dx relations are downstream; none are solved here. Worked example Operator-re-derived: simply-supported 6 m beam, P=30 kN down at 2 m, reactions Ay=20/By=10 kN given; cut at x=4 m, left portion SigmaFy: Ay - P - V = 20 - 30 - V = 0 -> V = -10 kN under the stated convention (positive upward on the left face). The cut is placed AFTER the load so the inclusion rule bites - forgetting P gives the wrong V=20; this is the distinguishing-feature-must-bite discipline, the same family as contact_force_modeling's single interface, applied and satisfied. Two-portion action-reaction check confirms V. TWO-signal mapping, both content-earned: sign_or_placement_error at step 5 (the SigmaFy/sign/inclusion step - the skill's crux, since V is meaningless without its sign), unclassified at step 7 (report/convention/diagram boundary). axis_confusion OMITTED: all loads transverse, no component-resolution step. solution_sequencing_error OMITTED although newly live this batch (adopted at 35c2ddb7): considered honestly and declined - reactions are given and no authored step strands a prerequisite unknown on an out-of-order solve, unlike the multi-member frame that earned the signal. The fifth signal is mapped only where earned, not defaulted onto a skill that does not exhibit its error class. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). This closes Batch 4F: skills 40-44 = three_force_member_identification, simple_truss_modeling, frame_machine_fbd, frame_machine_equilibrium, shear_force_internal_loading.
